content.text:
Draft PR created: https://github.com/entireio/cli/pull/727

The PR removes the stderr output for `ErrEmptyRepository` in the stop hook — the error is still handled gracefully (exit 0), but agents no longer see stderr output that they might misinterpret as a failure.
